login|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.login()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ select nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::json->>'login' $function$

via|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.via()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ select case when lower(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.headers',true),'')::json->>'x-client',''))='ai' then 'ai' else 'human' end $function$

my_company|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.my_company()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$ select company_id from api.app_user where login=private.login() $function$

ord|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ord(sid integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$ select ord from api.status where id=sid $function$

t_confirm_ins|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.t_confirm_ins()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$
begin
 if private.via()='ai' then raise exception 'confirmation must be given by a human, not by the agent' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 new.actor := private.login(); new.used:=false; new.ts:=now();
 return new; end $function$

consume|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.consume(p_op text, p_app integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$
declare cid bigint;
begin
 select id into cid from api.confirmation where actor=private.login() and op=p_op and app_id is not distinct from p_app and not used and ts>now()-interval '15 minutes' order by id limit 1 for update;
 if cid is null then return false; end if;
 update api.confirmation set used=true where id=cid; return true; end $function$
